description: This file contains Kotlin source code implementing gateway configuration resolution, parsing, validation, and handling logic for an Android application. It defines data classes, enums, and functions related to gateway endpoint configuration, setup code decoding, and security validation.

classes.name: GatewayEndpointConfig
classes.description: Data class representing the configuration of a gateway endpoint, including host, port, TLS usage, and display URL.

classes.name: GatewaySetupCode
classes.description: Data class representing a setup code containing URL, bootstrap token, token, and password.

classes.name: GatewayConnectConfig
classes.description: Data class encapsulating the configuration needed to connect to a gateway, including host, port, TLS, bootstrapping token, token, and password.

classes.name: GatewayEndpointValidationError
classes.description: Enum class defining validation errors for gateway endpoints, such as invalid URL or insecure remote URL.

classes.name: GatewayEndpointInputSource
classes.description: Enum class representing the input source for gateway endpoint data, e.g., setup code, manual entry, or QR scan.

classes.name: GatewayEndpointParseResult
classes.description: Data class encapsulating the result of parsing a gateway endpoint, including configuration and potential error.

classes.name: GatewayScannedSetupCodeResult
classes.description: Data class representing the outcome of scanning a setup code, including setup code string and error info.

methods.name: resolveGatewayConnectConfig
methods.description: Function that constructs a GatewayConnectConfig object based on input parameters, including setup code handling and manual URL parsing.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpoint
methods.description: Function that parses raw input into a GatewayEndpointConfig object, returning null if parsing fails.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointResult
methods.description: Function that parses a string URL into a GatewayEndpointParseResult, handling URL normalization, validation, and port determination.

methods.name: decodeGatewaySetupCode
methods.description: Function that decodes a Base64-encoded setup code JSON string into a GatewaySetupCode object.

methods.name: resolveScannedSetupCode
methods.description: Function that extracts a setup code string from raw input, attempting to decode it if necessary.

methods.name: resolveScannedSetupCodeResult
methods.description: Function that processes a raw input to provide detailed scan result including decoded setup code or errors.

methods.name: gatewayEndpointValidationMessage
methods.description: Function that generates a human-readable validation message based on error type and input source.

methods.name: composeGatewayManualUrl
methods.description: Constructs a manual gateway URL from host, port, and TLS flag, returning null if invalid inputs.
